description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (1.50 each), grants [Synchro Mode], [Damage Cap +10000], [Triple Sphere Mode III (Ice, Lightning, Water)] and [Third Activation Mode] to the user

description.name: Synchro Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands

description.name: Triple Sphere Mode III (Ice, Lightning, Water)
description.text: Grants [Attach Ice 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Lightning 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Water 2 with Stacking] after using a Ice/Lightning/Water ability

description.name: Third Activation Mode
description.text: Ice, Lightning and Water abilities trigger 1 additional time, casts Toy Break after using three Ice, Lightning or Water abilities
